title: Artome
blurb: Make artbooks, sketch journals and process notebooks on your phone: spreads with photos, drawings, annotations, version strips, timelines, spec cards and diagrams, laid out in the style of Japanese game artbooks. Flip through your book in 3D, place it on a table in AR, and export a print-ready PDF.
controls: Select: drag, corners to resize, round handle to rotate, double-tap to edit. Draw: pen, brush, pencil, marker, eraser (stylus pressure). Annotate: tap a spot and type. Add: elements and whole spread recipes. Frame icon on a photo to reframe it like a camera shot. Cube button: flip through the book in 3D; tap the right page to go forward, the left page to go back. View in AR: place it on a table (Android) or use live camera AR or AR Quick Look (iPhone)
